verdict.rationale: Asana ships automations (rules, AI Studio no-code automations, AI Teammates), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. The agent audit trail is an adjacent governance control, and the API deprecation and Asana-Enable/Disable headers govern API behavior, not user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
